page.title: Shipping & Returns
page.body_html:
Shipping

Every Wagvive order is packed and dispatched from our fulfilment partner's facility. We keep our pricing honest by shipping direct rather than holding inventory in a domestic warehouse — which keeps costs down, and means delivery takes a little longer than a same-country retailer.

Timelines

  • Processing: 1–3 business days
  • Delivery (US): typically 5–11 business days after dispatch
  • Tracking: emailed as soon as your parcel leaves the facility

Orders with multiple items may arrive in more than one parcel. That's normal — each tracking number is sent separately.

Shipping cost

  • Free standard shipping on orders over $60
  • $5.95 flat rate below that

Returns

If something isn't right, we want to fix it.

  • 30 days from delivery to start a return
  • Item should be unused and in its original packaging
  • Faulty, damaged, or incorrect items: we cover return shipping and send a replacement or full refund — your choice
  • Changed your mind: return shipping is the customer's responsibility

Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5–7 business days of us receiving the item.

Starting a return

Email hello@wagvive.com with your order number and a short note about the issue. A photo helps for damaged items. We'll reply within one business day.

Cancellations

Orders can be cancelled for a full refund any time before dispatch. Once tracking is issued, treat it as a return.
